items.title: Drug delivery’s next bottleneck isn’t innovation, it’s industrial capacity
items.summary: Drug delivery’s next bottleneck is manufacturing capacity: scale, validation, and resilient supply chains.

items.title: Sanofi and Regeneron expand immunology partnership to the tune of $8bn
items.summary: The agreement will see Sanofi and Regeneron co-develop and co-commercialise four long-lasting antibodies.

items.title: Varda pockets $251m to back space-based pharma processing mission
items.summary: Varda secures this capital as drugmakers tout the potential of manufacturing in microgravity conditions to create differentiated medicines.

items.title: Bristol Myers Squibb secures expanded US approval for Camzyos
items.summary: The US FDA has expanded the approved indication for BMS' Camzyos to treat symptomatic oHCM in adults and paediatric patients weighing at least 30 kg.

items.title: BioMarin and Profluent partner on AI-designed enzyme therapies
items.summary: BioMarin Pharmaceutical has entered into a research collaboration with Profluent to design and optimise novel enzyme therapies for its drug development pipeline.
